Franzi L

Simply Perfect
Sep 2026 • Couples
For us, Vie Hue is the best restaurant in Hue. The local cuisine is absolutely outstanding, with authentic flavors and beautifully prepared dishes. The cocktails are equally exceptional and add a special touch to the experience.

What truly makes Vie Hue stand out, though, is the team. Everyone is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and clearly passionate about what they do. The stylish interior, with its beautiful attention to detail, creates a wonderful atmosphere that makes you want to stay a little longer.

A fantastic place to experience local cuisine in a beautiful setting. We would happily come back anytime!
